verdict.rationale: Muse's docs show clear delegation-style features: an autonomous computer/terminal, tool-building for tasks, a Goals tab tracking multi-step work, and an activity log for review (muse-docs-1,5,7,8). However, hands-on community testing found the agent's control plane starts timing out under stress, exposing failure points in the exact architecture meant to support autonomous background work (muse-comm-1), directly contradicting the reliability of the claimed workflow. Missing for 10: independent success-case corroboration of a full task cycle (delegate→background work→review) completing without failure, and clarity on how often such timeouts occur in normal use.
